assertions.scope: Independent BRG30 fresh execution of complete source/runtime ZIP creation, verification, extraction and actual installed public tools. Actual current and historical d705 compilers exercise bundle/cache/explicit selection; original-byte capability/protocol/catalog/schema/codec/macro and exact-document identity faults must be observed before rejection. Actual immutable source/docs branches advance while installation retains exact pins; offline request counters remain zero, corrupt downloaded tools never execute, and handled update/lock interruptions preserve both prior tools, all receipts, exact docs and usable doctor. Runtime ZIP members and shipped migration/public commands execute. Disposable committed component tuples derive from this exact source and real generated docs; they are not the published release tuple. Controlled adversarial response/transport tests remain explicit controls. No K01-K05, RP42/RP44/RP45/RP46, published deployment, Apple execution, power-loss or concurrent-reader guarantee is inherited.
